purpose: Second benchmark evaluation budget policy: the same USD 5.00 ceiling and controls as v1, with the per-vendor concurrency and pace of the concurrent 8-model plan (captain order 2026-09-16: run all models on each question as concurrently as possible). The Gemini limits are the top-level fields; the subscription vendors carry their own limits in the vendors block. A larger ceiling needs a new policy file and a new reviewed gate.
ceiling_scope: cumulative benchmark_evaluation spend, reservations and ambiguous charges in the shared ledger; halt at exhaustion, no reset
scope: Google Gemini models only until another credential is enabled; evaluation spend counts toward the project lifetime ceiling and never toward dataset construction totals
concurrency_note: Gemini: 4 in flight and 30 per minute; the key's own quota is far above this and the construction run keeps its separate slots and window in the shared ledger. Claude Code and Codex: 3 in flight and 12 per minute each, because both quotas are shared with the live agent crews on this machine and one harness call takes 3 to 15 seconds.
